rationale: Price has gapped up 13.5% and is now trading well below both the session VWAP ($17.19) and the 9-EMA ($17.17), sitting at 45% of today's range after pulling back from the $17.97 high — indicating the initial momentum has faded without a clear directional setup. The last five 1-minute candles show declining volume and a drift lower with no decisive rejection or continuation signal, making both a long (below key averages in a weakening tape) and a short (still elevated relative to prior close with potential support nearby) unattractive risk/reward propositions. With the broader market under pressure (SPY -0.70%, VIXY +3.94%), the lack of a clean technical level to lean against warrants sitting out this cycle.
